sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Supply crate (Rare) (Supplies (Rare)) is a Reward Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Before Unlocking
sections.text: A trophy for participating in Arena battles. Outside the border, the contents of this box can hardly be considered valuable. However, Tarkov has its own notions of value. But first, you need to find a way to open this box.

sections.heading: After Unlocking
sections.text: A trophy for participating in Arena battles. Outside the border, the contents of this box can hardly be considered valuable. However, Tarkov has its own notions of value. The lock has been crudely broken, which means there are no more obstacles between you and the contents of the box.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Can only be opened outside of a raid
  - Must be un-locked at the Workbench level 1 before it can be opened
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
- Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")
- Only the locked version can be stashed in Lucky Scav Junk box

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Possible reward from Ref's daily and weekly quests for Arena

sections.heading: Crafting
sections.text: | Hand drill x1; Hand drill; +; Supply crate (Rare) x1; Locked Supply crate (Rare) | → | Workbench level 1; 1 minute | → | Supply crate (Rare) x1; Unlocked Supply crate (Rare) |

sections.heading: Loot Table
sections.text: The crate can contain various barter items, as well as medical items, stimulants and provisions.
